item.summary: fix(cron): reject blank/invalid --webhook before delivery.mode flip (#121533) * fix(cron): reject blank/invalid --webhook before delivery.mode flip Presence-only typeof checks treated empty or non-http --webhook as a delivery edit, forging mode=webhook with no URL and clearing the prior chat destination on merge. Validate with normalizeHttpWebhookUrl first.
